Fair call—planned as **R7** (`r7-kit-py-launch-updates-runner-on-takeover`, train `runners`, parent `R5`, prompt committed).

- Updates `runner` on every `kit.py launch` and `--take` (`agy` / `claude-cli` / `claude-web`) instead of leaving the planned runner stale.
- Stops `launch` from hard-coding `claude --bg` when running on `agy` (checks capacity, prepares the branch, updates the post, and prints `invoke_subagent`).
- Adds tests in `tests/test_launch_runtime.py`. Queued to run right after R5 lands.
